economics.confidence_note: The confirmation filter (close_position < 0.25 or > 0.75) accepts both extremes for either bar direction, so reversal-looking bars (bullish bars closing near the low, bearish bars closing near the high) are traded as continuation alongside the intended setups — a weakened signal but one the code implements consistently with its docstring; the result is a clear negative (score -0.29, gross -125 pts, commission 486 pts on 2430 trades / 384 sessions ≈ 6.3 trades per session), and gross is negative before costs so commissions are not deciding the sign.
